# Metrics

<!-- Generated by backend/tools/metrics_doc.py (`make docs`). Do not edit by hand. -->

Every processed save stores one value of each metric per tracked country. The *UI label* is the
name shown in the web interface. *Lower is better* only changes how changes are coloured
(a drop is shown as good) and the default sort direction.

Values come straight from the save: a field the game does not write (zero, false, empty) is 0.

## Economía (`economy`)

| Metric | UI label | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gold` | Tesoro (oro) | Treasury (gold) |  |
| `monthly_income` | Ingresos del mes | Gold income last month |  |
| `tax_income` | Impuestos del mes | Tax income last month |  |
| `trade_value` | Valor comercial mensual | Monthly trade value |  |
| `trade_balance` | Ingresos comerciales netos | Monthly trade balance |  |
| `inflation` | Inflación | Inflation | Lower is better |
| `maintenance` | Gasto mensual | Total maintenance last month |  |
| `total_produced` | Bienes producidos | Total goods produced |  |

## Yearly history

The game keeps a yearly record of a few values in each country. They are charted from that
record, which also covers the years before the first uploaded save.

| Metric | UI label | Description | Save field |
|---|---|---|---|
| `population` | Población (en miles) | Population, as recorded by the game once a year | `historical_population` |
| `tax_base` | Base impositiva | Tax base, as recorded by the game once a year | `historical_tax_base` |
| `economical_base` | Base económica | Economic base, as recorded by the game once a year | `historical_economical_base` |
